slides.title: Red Cross backs hospitals in Tigray and Amhara
slides.body: ICRC says shortages of health care, water and food are a pressing concern.

slides.title: Supplies sent to hospitals
slides.body: Oct 13–16: supplies reached hospitals in Shire, Maychew, Mehoni, Alamata and Mekelle. Relief kits are pre-positioned: 6,000 in Tigray, 2,000 in Amhara, 2,400 in Afar.
people were evacuated from Mekelle to Semera on Sept 28, with the ICRC as a neutral intermediary. It says safe passage needs agreement from all parties.
